system.description:
Communication with and control of animals (flyers and water beasts included; not intelligent or semi-intelligent beings, not the artificial creatures of the Underworld) within 12" for three turns.

Charges: roll d100 when found. Rechargeable with the Thoroughly Useful Eye.

How many exist: one. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
